## WebMCP islands (agent-friendly)
- places: [data-mcp="places"] — 73 places (places[] table; store-finder-markets.json)
- products: [data-mcp="products"] — KODIAK catalog
- market-languages: #lang-chips — top 2 outside English per market (ACS 2023, 74 language markets) — market-languages.json
- preview.compose: [data-mcp="preview.compose"] — message overlay on final posts (EN + localized)
- brief-yaml: #brief — copyable campaign brief
- webmcp.json — manifest; application/ld+json WebApplication in footer

## Pipeline (local, operator-driven)
brief (JSON/YAML) -> DAM reuse or Nova Canvas hero -> enhance -> compose 1:1/9:16/16:9 -> compliance -> report.json + preview.html
translate: Nova Micro -> Amazon Translate -> offline dict -> tagged — auto per market (El Paso ES, Burlington FR, SF Pescadero ZH)
storage: DAM bucket s3://chasko-creative-dam-946179428633-us-east-1/brands/kodiak/ is private (CLI/SDK only via `aws s3`, not browser-fetchable); public playground https://d37333alc7ojpl.cloudfront.net/
